'''Derenzil''' was a [[Swamp/Legends|swamp]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Prior to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], it was the site of a brief civil war during which the [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosians]] manufactured and supplied [[Sonic weapon/Legends|sonic weapons]] that had been specialized for aquatic environments to both sides.<ref name="Star Wars: Complete Locations 2005" />
